title: 比較
source_framework: FACTBOOK Chapter 8, FACT 145-162 + unnumbered comparison expressions (pp.244, 249-250)

topics.title: 原級・比較級・最上級の基本
topics.pattern_hint: tall → taller → the tallest / useful → more useful → the most useful
topics.teacher_note: 原級・比較級・最上級を同じ形容詞から作る。-er/-est と more/most の使い分けを学ぶ。

sentences.english: My room is small.
sentences.japanese: 私の部屋は小さいです。

sentences.english: My room is smaller than my brother’s.
sentences.japanese: 私の部屋は兄の部屋より小さいです。

sentences.english: This is the smallest room in our house.
sentences.japanese: これは私たちの家で一番小さい部屋です。

sentences.english: This method is more useful than the old one.
sentences.japanese: この方法は以前の方法より役に立ちます。

sentences.english: That was the most exciting moment of the game.
sentences.japanese: あれは試合で最もわくわくした瞬間でした。

topics.title: as ... as の基本
topics.pattern_hint: as + 原級 + as ...（…と同じくらい～）
topics.teacher_note: as と as の間に原級を入れる。形容詞だけでなく副詞でも使う。

sentences.english: My bag is as heavy as yours.
sentences.japanese: 私のかばんはあなたのかばんと同じくらい重いです。

sentences.english: This question is as easy as the first one.
sentences.japanese: この問題は最初の問題と同じくらい簡単です。

sentences.english: She runs as fast as her brother.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は兄と同じくらい速く走ります。

sentences.english: The new library is as quiet as the old one.
sentences.japanese: 新しい図書館は古い図書館と同じくらい静かです。

sentences.english: I can speak as clearly as my teacher.
sentences.japanese: 私は先生と同じくらい明瞭に話すことができます。

topics.title: not as ... as（…ほど～でない）
topics.pattern_hint: not as + 原級 + as ...
topics.teacher_note: as ... as を否定し、比較する相手ほどの程度に達していないことを表す。

sentences.english: This test is not as difficult as I expected.
sentences.japanese: このテストは思ったほど難しくありません。

sentences.english: I am not as tall as my sister.
sentences.japanese: 私は姉ほど背が高くありません。

sentences.english: This river is not as wide as that one.
sentences.japanese: この川はあの川ほど幅が広くありません。

sentences.english: He does not speak as slowly as his teacher.
sentences.japanese: 彼は先生ほどゆっくり話しません。

sentences.english: The second movie was not as interesting as the first.
sentences.japanese: 2作目の映画は1作目ほど面白くありませんでした。

topics.title: as ... as の程度・倍数
topics.pattern_hint: almost / just / twice / three times + as ... as
topics.teacher_note: almost, justなどで程度を示す。倍数を表すときはtwice as ... asなどを使う。

sentences.english: This desk is almost as wide as that table.
sentences.japanese: この机はあのテーブルとほぼ同じ幅です。

sentences.english: My shoes are just as comfortable as yours.
sentences.japanese: 私の靴はあなたの靴とまったく同じくらい快適です。

sentences.english: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
sentences.japanese: この箱はあの箱の2倍の重さです。

sentences.english: Our new classroom is three times as large as the old one.
sentences.japanese: 私たちの新しい教室は以前の教室の3倍の広さです。

sentences.english: This glass holds half as much water as that bottle.
sentences.japanese: このコップにはあのボトルの半分の量の水が入ります。

topics.title: as many / much / good ... as
topics.pattern_hint: as many + 複数名詞 + as / as much + 不可算名詞 + as
topics.teacher_note: 比較の中心は形容詞一語に限られない。数・量・得意さなどのまとまりを比較する。

sentences.english: I have as many books as my sister.
sentences.japanese: 私は姉と同じくらいの冊数の本を持っています。

sentences.english: We need as much time as they do.
sentences.japanese: 私たちには彼らと同じくらいの時間が必要です。

sentences.english: She is as good at swimming as her brother.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は兄と同じくらい水泳が得意です。

sentences.english: Our school has as many exchange students as theirs.
sentences.japanese: 私たちの学校には彼らの学校と同じくらいの人数の交換留学生がいます。

sentences.english: I do not spend as much money on games as I used to.
sentences.japanese: 私は以前ほどゲームにお金を使いません。

topics.title: 比較するものをそろえる（原級）
topics.pattern_hint: as ... as：人と人／行動と行動／場所と場所
topics.teacher_note: 同じ基準のもの同士を比べる。比べる対象がずれて意味が不自然にならないようにする。

sentences.english: Studying at home is as effective as studying at school.
sentences.japanese: 家で勉強することは学校で勉強することと同じくらい効果的です。

sentences.english: My bicycle is as light as yours.
sentences.japanese: 私の自転車はあなたの自転車と同じくらい軽いです。

sentences.english: I can relax at the park as easily as at home.
sentences.japanese: 私は家にいるときと同じくらい公園でも気楽にくつろげます。

sentences.english: Speaking English is not as easy as reading English.
sentences.japanese: 英語を話すことは英語を読むことほど簡単ではありません。

sentences.english: The weather in Nagoya is as hot as the weather in Osaka today.
sentences.japanese: 今日の名古屋の天気は大阪の天気と同じくらい暑いです。

topics.title: as ... as の後ろに節を置く
topics.pattern_hint: as + 原級 + as + 主語 + 動詞
topics.teacher_note: 比較の基準を as 以下の節で示す。文脈上明らかな語が省略されることがある。

sentences.english: This movie is not as funny as I thought.
sentences.japanese: この映画は思っていたほど面白くありません。

sentences.english: She is as kind as everyone says she is.
sentences.japanese: 彼女はみんなが言うとおりに親切です。

sentences.english: The room is not as bright as it looks.
sentences.japanese: その部屋は見た目ほど明るくありません。

sentences.english: He can sing as well as he did before.
sentences.japanese: 彼は以前と同じくらい上手に歌えます。

sentences.english: The project was not as simple as we had expected.
sentences.japanese: その計画は私たちが予想していたほど単純ではありませんでした。

topics.title: as many as / as much as（驚き）
topics.pattern_hint: as many as + 数 / as much as + 量・金額
topics.teacher_note: 数量が思ったより多いという驚き・強調を表す。単なる同等比較とは区別する。

sentences.english: As many as fifty students joined the event.
sentences.japanese: そのイベントには50人もの生徒が参加しました。

sentences.english: The ticket costs as much as ten thousand yen.
sentences.japanese: そのチケットは1万円もします。

sentences.english: She reads as many as six books a month.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は1か月に6冊もの本を読みます。

sentences.english: We waited for as long as three hours.
sentences.japanese: 私たちは3時間も待ちました。

sentences.english: As many as two hundred people attended the online meeting.
sentences.japanese: オンライン会議には200人もの人が参加しました。

topics.title: 比較級の基本
topics.pattern_hint: -er / more ...（さらに～・より～）
topics.teacher_note: thanを伴わなくても、比較級だけで以前より高い程度を示せる。

sentences.english: Please speak a little louder.
sentences.japanese: もう少し大きな声で話してください。

sentences.english: The weather is getting warmer.
sentences.japanese: 天気がだんだん暖かくなっています。

sentences.english: I need a bigger bag.
sentences.japanese: 私はもっと大きなかばんが必要です。

sentences.english: We should choose a more practical solution.
sentences.japanese: 私たちはもっと実用的な解決策を選ぶべきです。

sentences.english: You can explain your ideas more clearly.
sentences.japanese: あなたは自分の考えをもっと明確に説明できます。

topics.title: 比較級＋than
topics.pattern_hint: 比較級 + than + 比較対象
topics.teacher_note: 比較する相手・ものを than で示す。比較級の後ろに比較対象が続く。

sentences.english: This road is shorter than that one.
sentences.japanese: この道はあの道より短いです。

sentences.english: My brother is older than I am.
sentences.japanese: 兄は私より年上です。

sentences.english: The train is faster than the bus.
sentences.japanese: 電車はバスより速いです。

sentences.english: This book is more interesting than the movie.
sentences.japanese: この本はその映画より面白いです。

sentences.english: She answered the question more confidently than I did.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は私より自信を持ってその質問に答えました。

topics.title: much / far / a little＋比較級
topics.pattern_hint: much / far / a lot / a little + 比較級
topics.teacher_note: 比較による差の程度を表す。very tallerのようにveryを比較級に直接置かない。

sentences.english: This chair is much more comfortable than that one.
sentences.japanese: この椅子はあの椅子よりずっと座り心地がよいです。

sentences.english: My new phone is a little lighter than my old one.
sentences.japanese: 新しい携帯電話は古いものより少し軽いです。

sentences.english: The second task is far more difficult than the first.
sentences.japanese: 2つ目の課題は最初の課題よりはるかに難しいです。

sentences.english: She is two years younger than I am.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は私より2歳年下です。

sentences.english: We need three more chairs for the guests.
sentences.japanese: お客さんのために椅子があと3脚必要です。

topics.title: 比較級の倍数表現
topics.pattern_hint: three times + 比較級 + than ...
topics.teacher_note: 倍数を比較級の前に置き、程度の大きな差を表す。数量の比の解釈には注意する。

sentences.english: This new printer works three times faster than the old one.
sentences.japanese: この新しいプリンターは古いものより3倍速く動きます。

sentences.english: The new battery lasts four times longer than the previous model.
sentences.japanese: 新しい電池は前のモデルより4倍長持ちします。

sentences.english: This building is five times taller than our school building.
sentences.japanese: この建物は私たちの校舎より5倍高いです。

sentences.english: The updated system processes data ten times faster than before.
sentences.japanese: 更新されたシステムは以前より10倍速くデータを処理します。

sentences.english: That camera is three times more expensive than mine.
sentences.japanese: あのカメラは私のカメラの3倍の値段がします。

topics.title: 比較するものをそろえる（比較級）
topics.pattern_hint: 比較級 + than：行動・場所・人などを対応させる
topics.teacher_note: thanの前後で比較する要素を揃える。人と人、行動と行動など同種のものを比較する。

sentences.english: Walking to school is healthier than taking a taxi.
sentences.japanese: 学校まで歩くことはタクシーに乗ることより健康によいです。

sentences.english: Eating breakfast at home is cheaper than eating at a café.
sentences.japanese: 家で朝食を食べることはカフェで食べることより安上がりです。

sentences.english: My sister’s English is better than mine.
sentences.japanese: 姉の英語力は私の英語力より高いです。

sentences.english: It is easier to learn with friends than to study alone.
sentences.japanese: 一人で勉強するより友だちと学ぶ方が簡単です。

sentences.english: The climate in this city is warmer than that in my hometown.
sentences.japanese: この都市の気候は私の故郷の気候より暖かいです。

topics.title: than の後ろに節を置く
topics.pattern_hint: 比較級 + than + 主語 + 動詞
topics.teacher_note: 比較の基準をthan以下の節で示す。than I expected / than he looksなど。

sentences.english: The exam was harder than I expected.
sentences.japanese: 試験は私が予想していたより難しかったです。

sentences.english: She looks younger than she actually is.
sentences.japanese: 彼女は実際の年齢より若く見えます。

sentences.english: The journey took longer than we had planned.
sentences.japanese: その旅は私たちが計画していたより時間がかかりました。

sentences.english: I feel more relaxed than I did yesterday.
sentences.japanese: 私は昨日より気持ちが落ち着いています。

sentences.english: The new system is more useful than we first thought.
sentences.japanese: 新しいシステムは私たちが最初に考えたより役に立ちます。

topics.title: 最上級の基本
topics.pattern_hint: the + -est / the most + 形容詞・副詞
topics.teacher_note: 最上級で比較集団の中の一番を表す。副詞の最上級ではtheが省かれる場合がある。

sentences.english: This is the tallest building in our town.
sentences.japanese: これは私たちの町で最も高い建物です。

sentences.english: She is the fastest runner on the team.
sentences.japanese: 彼女はチームで最も足の速い走者です。

sentences.english: This is the most useful app on my phone.
sentences.japanese: これは私の携帯電話で最も役立つアプリです。

sentences.english: Of all the students, he speaks English the most fluently.
sentences.japanese: 生徒全員の中で、彼が最も流暢に英語を話します。

sentences.english: That was the best meal of our trip.
sentences.japanese: あれは旅行中で一番おいしい食事でした。

topics.title: 最上級の範囲（in / of）
topics.pattern_hint: the 最上級 + in + 範囲 / of + 集合
topics.teacher_note: エリア・グループ内ならin、全体の一部という関係ならofを使うのが典型。

sentences.english: Mika is the youngest student in our class.
sentences.japanese: ミカはクラスで最も年下の生徒です。

sentences.english: This is the largest park in the city.
sentences.japanese: これは市内で最も広い公園です。

sentences.english: Ken is the tallest of the four boys.
sentences.japanese: ケンは4人の少年の中で最も背が高いです。

sentences.english: That question was the hardest of all.
sentences.japanese: あの問題はすべての中で最も難しかったです。

sentences.english: Which is the most popular sport in your country?
sentences.japanese: あなたの国で最も人気のあるスポーツは何ですか。

topics.title: 最上級の強調・順位
topics.pattern_hint: by far the 最上級 / the very 最上級 / the second 最上級
topics.teacher_note: by farやveryで最上級を強調し、序数詞で順位を表す。

sentences.english: This is by far the best answer.
sentences.japanese: これは断然最もよい答えです。

sentences.english: She is the very best singer in the group.
sentences.japanese: 彼女はグループの中でまさに最高の歌手です。

sentences.english: This is the second longest river in the country.
sentences.japanese: これはその国で2番目に長い川です。

sentences.english: He won the third largest prize in the competition.
sentences.japanese: 彼はその大会で3番目に大きな賞を獲得しました。

sentences.english: This is by far the most challenging project I have worked on.
sentences.japanese: これは私が取り組んだ中で断然最も難しいプロジェクトです。

topics.title: 原級・比較級で最上級を表す
topics.pattern_hint: no other ... as ... as / 比較級 + than any other ...
topics.teacher_note: 最上級を用いずに「一番」を表す。any otherの後ろは単数可算名詞が基本。

sentences.english: No other student in this class is as tall as Yuki.
sentences.japanese: このクラスでユキほど背の高い生徒はほかにいません。

sentences.english: Yuki is taller than any other student in this class.
sentences.japanese: ユキはこのクラスのほかのどの生徒よりも背が高いです。

sentences.english: No other mountain on this island is higher than this one.
sentences.japanese: この島にはこの山より高い山はほかにありません。

sentences.english: Nothing is more important than your health.
sentences.japanese: 健康より大切なものはありません。

sentences.english: Our captain is more experienced than anyone else on the team.
sentences.japanese: 私たちのキャプテンはチームのほかの誰よりも経験豊富です。

topics.title: 重要比較表現①：変化と比例
topics.pattern_hint: better and better / more and more / the 比較級 ..., the 比較級 ...
topics.teacher_note: FACT番号なしの重要表現。比較級の反復は変化、the 比較級の対は比例関係を表す。

sentences.english: My pronunciation is getting better and better.
sentences.japanese: 私の発音はどんどんよくなっています。

sentences.english: The days are getting shorter and shorter.
sentences.japanese: 日がだんだん短くなっています。

sentences.english: This topic is becoming more and more interesting.
sentences.japanese: この話題はますます面白くなっています。

sentences.english: The more you practice, the more confident you become.
sentences.japanese: 練習すればするほど自信がつきます。

sentences.english: The earlier we leave, the sooner we will arrive.
sentences.japanese: 早く出発すればするほど早く到着します。

topics.title: 重要比較表現②：最上級の決まり文句
topics.pattern_hint: one of the 最上級 + 複数名詞 / the best ... I have ever ... / at least
topics.teacher_note: FACT番号なしの重要表現。one ofの後ろは複数名詞、経験最上級とat least/mostを練習する。

sentences.english: Kyoto is one of the most popular cities in Japan.
sentences.japanese: 京都は日本で最も人気のある都市の一つです。

sentences.english: This is the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen.
sentences.japanese: これは私が今まで見た中で最も美しい夕焼けです。

sentences.english: We need at least ten volunteers.
sentences.japanese: 私たちには少なくとも10人のボランティアが必要です。

sentences.english: At most, twenty people can enter this room.
sentences.japanese: この部屋には多くても20人しか入れません。

sentences.english: Even the best players make mistakes sometimes.
sentences.japanese: 最高の選手でさえ、ときには間違いをします。
